title: SEO Page Audit (On-Page SEO Checker)
description: Audit web pages for on-page SEO in bulk: title and meta description length, headings, canonical, noindex, mobile viewport, image alt text, links, word count, Open Graph, schema.org, HTTPS and speed. Each page gets a 0-100 score and a plain list of issues to fix.

urls.title: Page URLs
urls.description: Pages to audit, one per line (up to 10,000 per run). Tip: feed it the output of a sitemap extractor to audit a whole site.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages the site asks bots not to fetch. Turn off only for your own sites.

page.title: Page audited
page.description: One page fetched and audited (including 404 and 500 pages, which the audit reports). Unreachable, blocked or non-HTML URLs are free.

store.seoTitle: SEO Page Audit - Bulk On-Page SEO Checker
store.seoDescription: Bulk on-page SEO audit: titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonical, noindex, alt text, links, schema, speed. Score and issue list per page.
